subject: ensuring dimensions yield circles when using polar coordinates

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: ensuring dimensions yield circles when using polar coordinates
parts:
Hi all,

I'm using ggplot2 to display a parameter space (values of kappa
specifying a Von Mises distribution) that consists of circles. The
code below yields a 2x5 matrix of circles, or at least it should; I've
attempted to specify the pdf dimensions by hand to make sure the
circles are truly circles and not elliptical, but I'd like to know if
there's any way to have the dimensions set automatically to ensure the
circles are true circles. Any thoughts?

library(CircStats)
library(ggplot2)

kappa = exp(seq(0,4,length.out=10))
x = seq(-180,180,10)

a = ldply(
kappa
, .fun = function(kappa){
d = dvm(x*pi/180,0,kappa)
d = d-min(d)
d = d/max(d)
to_return = data.frame(
kappa = kappa
, x = x
, d = d
)
return(to_return)
}
)
p = ggplot(
data = a
, mapping = aes(
x = x
, y = factor(1)
, colour = d
, fill = d
)
)+facet_wrap(~kappa,ncol=5,as.table=FALSE)+
geom_bar(
width=1
,stat='identity'
)+scale_fill_gradient(
low = muted('blue')
, high = muted('red')
, space = 'Lab'
)+scale_colour_gradient(
low = muted('blue')
, high = muted('red')
, space = 'Lab'
)+scale_y_discrete(
name=''
,breaks=100
)+scale_x_continuous(
name=''
,breaks=0
)+coord_polar(
theta='x'
)+opts(
legend.position='none'
, panel.grid.major = theme_blank()
, panel.grid.minor = theme_blank()
, axis.title.y = theme_blank()
, axis.text.y = theme_blank()
, axis.title.x = theme_blank()
, axis.text.x = theme_blank()
, axis.ticks = theme_blank()
)
ggsave(p,file='kappa_space.pdf',width = 10,height = 4.5)


--
Mike Lawrence
Graduate Student
Department of Psychology
Dalhousie University

messages.subject: Re: ensuring dimensions yield circles when using polar coordinates
parts:
Hi Mike,

I think aspect.ratio = 1 should do this (and is the default when using
coord_polar) but is unfortunately broken in the current version. It's
on my todo list.

Hadley
